name: garmin-personal-api-mcpb
description: Read-only Claude Desktop extension for the official Garmin Connect Personal API

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.js --bundle --platform=node --target=node18 --format=esm --outfile=server/index.js --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
scripts.pack: npm run build && mcpb pack . garmin-personal-api.mcpb
